name: Kung Pao Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb / 500g chicken thigh, cut into bite size pieces
6-10 dried chillies, cut into 2cm pieces, most seeds discarded
3 green onions, cut into 2cm pieces, white parts separated from green
3/4 cup whole peanuts (or 1/2 cup halved), roasted unsalted
unmapped: Chinese black vinegar (Chinkiang) - no board id; nearest is rice-vinegar/balsamic but distinct. Signature ingredient, good pricer-lane probe.
Chinese cooking wine (Shaoxing) - no board id; loosely white-wine/mirin but neither is a true match.
ground Sichuan peppercorns - no board id (board has black-peppercorns only); signature Sichuan flavor, deliberate board gap.
dark soy sauce - board has soy-sauce and sweet-soy-sauce; dark soy is a near-substitute, flagged as a soft gap.
why: Skillet/wok stir-fry chicken with NO rice base - the published card macros are dish-only (rice served separately). Read straight off the recipe card: 555 cal / 28 g protein / 18 g carb per serving, sitting mid-band on calories and comfortably under the 35 g carb ceiling even with the 3 tbsp sugar in the sauce. Chicken thighs (board id chicken-thighs) flash-fried with peanuts, dried chilies, garlic and ginger in a soy/vinegar pan sauce. Adds Chinese/Sichuan breadth to a chicken-skillet pool otherwise thick with creamy-Italian pan sauces; distinct from the existing Thai cashew stir-fry (different cuisine, aromatics, and nut). Batch-scales to 14 as ~3.5x done in wok shifts, weigh-and-divide. Three genuinely-unmapped signature ingredients (Sichuan peppercorns, Shaoxing wine, black vinegar) make it a strong pricer-lane probe. Confidence high - nutrition verified on the source page.
